[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1n6[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]E2: Exact-candidate release train and steward[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every sase release is a sealed candidate built once at its tag: the[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]wheel and sdist plus an exact `sase-core-rs==X.Y.Z` with its full [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]file set and digests. It is qualified against the published core, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exercised on Linux and macOS, published from the retained bytes [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with digest-checked resume, and confirmed from PyPI before it is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]un-drafted. One stateless steward decides release merges and the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]core cut, and every blocked release names a typed reason and its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]owner.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]10[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202610/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]e2_release_train_steward.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/e2_release_train_steward.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-1n6[/#87AFFF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Core-cut resilience and the in-flight retention source[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-release[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-release: in sase-core, the release-plz merge job reruns failed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]checks once and emits a typed CORE_CUT_RED, and retention also protects [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the exact core pins of sase tags not yet on PyPI.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]release.yml builds once at the tag and seals the candidate [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]manifest[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]exact-build[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]exact-build: a new tag-dispatched release.yml with an identity [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]assertion, one build, a sealed candidate manifest stashed on the draft [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]release, a rehearse mode, and the gate for the PyPI publisher and tag [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]policy.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Exact core pin and the shared core-ensure rule[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-pin[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-pin: ratchet_core_pin writes sase-core-rs==X.Y.Z chosen by one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shared core-ensure rule, master converts to the exact form, and every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tool that assumed a window accepts the pin.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Exercise the exact files on Linux and macOS[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]exercise[dim] · [dim][/dim]after exact-build[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]exercise: release.yml installs the stashed wheel and sdist into clean [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]environments on Linux and macOS and runs a no-LLM fakey workflow, an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]upgrade from N-1, and pip check.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Qualify the candidate against the published core[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]qualify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after exact-build, core-pin, exercise[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]qualify: ci.yml gains ref and core-source inputs, a versioned N1 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inventory decides what blocks, and release.yml qualifies against the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exact published core with fail-closed evidence.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Digest-checked publish, PyPI confirmation, and un-draft[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]publish[dim] · [dim][/dim]after qualify[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]publish: release.yml uploads only missing files after digest checks, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]confirms every file and an exact install from PyPI, runs the family [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]canary, then un-drafts; a resume mode re-enters at publish.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stateless release steward in observe mode[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]steward[dim] · [dim][/dim]after exact-build, core-pin, core-release[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]steward: tools/release_watch becomes a stateless reconciler with typed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]states, one idempotent action per tick, core-ensure, bounded reruns, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]abandonment, and 24h escalation, running observe-only.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Release-green record and release metrics[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]metrics[dim] · [dim][/dim]after steward[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]metrics: a read-only tools/release_metrics derives release-green per SHA[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the release figures, each with numerator, denominator and window, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and publishes a pre-train baseline.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Cut releases over to release.yml and hand merges to the [/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]steward[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]handover[dim] · [dim][/dim]after publish, steward, metrics[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]handover: release-please goes draft with forced tags, publish.yml keeps [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]only release-please and metadata sync, the steward goes live, ci_watch [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]drops sase releases, and a gate hands over merge authority.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]First steward release, acceptance evidence, and the decision [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
       [bold #D7AFFF]record[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]exit[dim] · [dim][/dim]after handover[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]exit: confirm the human handover steps, watch the first real release [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through the steward, prove digests and attestation match the manifest, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record acceptance evidence, and apply the memory decisions.[/#D7D7AF]
